name: Pairwise Comparison
description: Prioritize criteria through systematic pairwise comparison. Every criterion is judged against every other.
whenToUse: When a handful of equally ranked criteria needs a justified order and handing out points directly would be too arbitrary — every criterion is put against every other one, three to fifteen criteria; not when the criteria are to be weighted against SEVERAL outputs, which is what the C&E matrix is for.
emptyHint: Add at least {n} criteria to start the comparison.
noResults: No results yet — please add criteria and run the comparison first.
duplicateWarning: This criterion has already been added.

invariants.reachablePhase: The displayed tab must match the run: Comparison only while a comparison is running, Result only once it is finished.
